evidence: The narrow coverage observation is true: tests/service/normal_unrenderable_controls.rs:7,12,321 exercise successful service pulls, and the SQL-failure cases at tests/service/delivery_pull.rs:11610,13070 and tests/service/q4_retirement_refusal_controls.rs:483 exercise different ordinary-source paths. However, the required end-to-end materiality demonstration stops there. TRUST-POLICY.md:1755-1778 explicitly accepts skipping a previously unknown unrenderable candidate for a finite private capture and retaining progress after successful commit; only pre-commit refusal/actual rollback must install none. The new branch at src/store/invitation_content.rs:2632-2638 changes only a local processed count; carry removal at :2728-2731 changes the local State loaded at :2170. Its only consumer persistence is the shared save at :2855, whose single upsert propagates failure at :518-519. SqliteStore::presentation_pull at src/store/mod.rs:1297-1311 executes the entire pull as predecision work within execute_budgeted_decision. src/store/connection.rs:358-383 returns validation errors before the sole commit; tests/store/writer_budget.rs:414-444 explicitly check rollback, restored stored values and autocommit for that shared wrapper. The neighboring late-save retirement control at tests/service/q4_retirement_refusal_controls.rs:483-498 compares complete consumer/item/proof/cursor/receipt/Lazy state through bookend at :195-228 after an aborted final consumer update. Furthermore, src/service/delivery_presentation.rs:199-216 propagates the store error before any post-store offer/cache/replay installation at :228-288. No branch-specific durable write, external progress mutation or bypass of those tested failure boundaries was found. Thus a failed final save is not shown to suppress unseen mail or contradict the rollback requirement; a branch-specific fault test would strengthen coverage, but absent an explicit requirement for that exact case or evidence of a material unprotected mechanism, its absence alone does not establish this review issue. This is an internal structural judgment; no runtime test was run. The V2 implementation is newly added relative to base565def86, where src/store/invitation_content.rs does not exist.
